courses.summary: 大慶是中國重要油田系統，包含成熟開發與新型資源研究；課程著重資料分區和含水處理帳。本課依序分析高含水情境的總液量、不同區塊的有效體積、產油與回收概念區分、處理水回用量帳、年代不同資料的對齊，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Daqing is a major Chinese oilfield system with mature development and new-resource research; this case examines compartment data and water handling. The course analyses total liquid in a high-water-cut scenario, net volume of distinct blocks, distinguishing oil output from recovery, treated-water reuse balance, alignment of datasets from different periods, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
